message.content:
This document is a technical README and engineering log for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on NVIDIA and AMD hardware. Key technical points:

**Architecture & Memory**
- Expert-tiered memory: hot experts in VRAM, overflow in pinned RAM, remainder streamed from NVMe SSD via mmap; dense weights in VRAM.
- Supports multi-GPU layer splits (up to 16 GPUs), tensor parallel, and an experimental
